caption:
Figure 6: Overview of FAIR’s two-stage training. Stage 1 learns a general restoration prior. Stage 2
conditions restoration on region control R and guidance P = (t, v), using region-aware supervision
to bind the guidance to its target region.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final full figure and read source-pair evidence and caption. Entire original FAIR scientific graph retains R and P conditioning, shared VAE, Qwen3/text/image branches, two curricula and losses. Full coastline/cactus guidance, region control and inside/outside color encoding are original pixels. New titles/footer simply define R and P=(t,v) and two stages. No extra weighting→heatmap edge or inferred snowflake meaning was introduced.
